title: Winspace warranty policy recheck
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. The warranty starts when the goods arrive at the original buyer's location and lasts three years for framesets and two years for wheelsets. It covers manufacturing defects only and excludes damage from misuse, failure to follow user instructions, lack of maintenance or non-conforming use. The earlier 2026-08-27 record is unchanged.
